denominators.cpu: jdk.ExecutionSample Java event count, all recorded threads; excludes NativeMethodSample and native GC/JIT workers
denominators.allocation: jdk.ObjectAllocationSample weight bytes; sampled total, not retained heap or exact allocation; no-stack weights retained in denominator
denominators.inclusive: one normalized class.method membership per event; shares overlap, not additive
denominators.wall: phase boundaries from UTC millisecond logs; main engine split from reconstructed joined duration; short cleanup reported separately
denominators.capture: GC pause union is clipped per window; heap capture windows are separate and contain native work not represented by Java execution samples
denominators.availability: Recording metadata and observed span do not prove continuous capture. Empty/short windows are insufficient evidence for detailed attribution.
